rules.b:
15U–17U: 2:00 no new inning. Championship game has no time limit.
13U–14U pool play: 1:50 no new inning.
12U pool play: 1:45 no new inning.
12U–14U A bracket: 2:00 no new inning, extra-inning format if time hits before the 7th. Championship has no time limit.
Lower brackets: 1:50 (13U–14U), 1:45 (12U).
Game time starts with the first warm-up pitch.

15U–17U: BBCOR (-3) or wood.
14U: BBCOR, wood or -5 (Prospects is not adopting the -3 mandate for 14U).
13U: -3, -5, -8.
12U: -3, -5, -8, -10.

Youth (12U–14U): 15 after 3, 12 after 4, 8 after 5.
High school (15U–17U): 15 after 4, 10 after 5.
Pool games can end in a tie when time expires or after 6 innings (12U) / 7 innings (13U+).
Bracket games: tie after 7 or at the time limit goes to a runner on 2nd with 1 out (not used in the championship).

Bat 9 or the full lineup (extra hitters allowed). No DH for youth; 15U–17U may use DH and Pitcher/DH. Pitcher-only players don’t have to hit.
Courtesy runners allowed for pitcher and catcher. 1st-to-3rd move allowed.
No pitch-count limits, but staff will require a substitution if a pitcher is clearly overused.
15U–17U: one mound visit per inning; the second removes the pitcher.
High school coaches text a photo of their game-one lineup card to 612-718-5254.
Rosters are on the USSSA site. A player can’t be rostered on more than one team in the same age level; violations can mean disqualification and forfeit.

1. Winning percentage
2. Most wins
3. Fewest losses
4. Head-to-head (two-team ties only)
5. Average runs allowed
6. Average run differential (max 8 per game)
7. Most runs scored
With three or more teams tied, head-to-head is skipped and never revisited.

Every event is pool play followed by brackets. The director creates a coaches’ group text the Wednesday/Thursday before each event for weather updates.
Pool games are official after 2.5 innings (home team leading) or 45 minutes; 15U–17U after 3.5 innings. Shortened games before that are “no contest.”
4-game guarantee: 0 games started = entry minus $200; 1 = 50%; 2 = 25%; 3 = no refund.
3-game guarantee: 0 started = entry minus $100; 1 = 25%; 2 = no refund.
Withdraw by the entry deadline: entry minus $100. After the deadline: no refund. Unpaid teams are charged 10% per day.

An ejected coach sits the rest of that game and the next. Player ejections sit the rest of the game and may face more.
No outside food or drinks (player water jugs are fine). No soft toss against backstops or fences. Please clean up your dugout.

Pool play followed by brackets. With multiple pools, teams are always re-seeded so the top overall teams get the top seeds.
Top-bracket games on Sunday have two umpires; consolation games have one. Most Saturday games have one umpire.

10U: 60 ft bases / 46 ft mound. Dropped 3rd strike is an out, stealing on release and leading off allowed, no scoring on passed balls or wild pitches.
11U–12U: 70 ft / 50 ft (some fields use 75 ft bases).
13U: 80 ft / 54 ft (75 ft bases may be used at Johnny Cake Ridge).
14U–18U: 90 ft / 60 ft 6 in.
11U–18U play straight baseball.

10U–13U: no specific bat rule (USSSA, USA, BBCOR or wood).
14U: USSSA/USA (-5 or -3) or BBCOR/wood. Wood or -3 recommended.
15U–18U: BBCOR or wood.

15U–18U: 2:00 no new inning; championship has no time limit.
13U–14U pool play: 1:50 no new inning.
11U–12U pool play: 1:45 no new inning.
11U–14U A bracket: 2:00 no new inning, extra-inning format if time hits before the 7th.

Youth: 15 after 3, 12 after 4, 8 after 5. High school: 15 after 4, 10 after 5.
Bracket ties go to a runner on 2nd with 1 out (not in the championship).
No pitching restrictions, but the maximum for the weekend is 140 pitches per player. DH allowed for 15U–18U.

Lightning within 10 miles and moving toward the field means a delay, rechecked every 15 minutes, until it’s 5+ miles away and moving off.
A game stopped for darkness must reach 3.5 innings to count.
Coaches: text 612-718-5254 to join the weekend weather group chat.

1. Winning percentage
2. Most wins
3. Fewest losses
4. Head-to-head (two-team ties only)
5. Average runs allowed
6. Average run differential (max 8 per game)
7. Most runs scored

Send one copy of your organization’s team insurance to michael@minnesotabaseballacademy.com.
Please keep a GameChanger and send the team link to the director.
3-game guarantee refunds: 0 games started = entry and prepaid gate minus $100; 1 = 50%; 2 = no refund. Withdraw by the entry deadline: entry minus $100.
Metal spikes on fields that prohibit them can bring a fine of up to $2,000.

about.blurb: Premier Minnesota tournament provider since 2009. Youth events (12U–14U) are USSSA-sanctioned, high school divisions play each summer under the Prospects banner, and the Advanced Fall Baseball League (AFBL) runs 10U–18U every fall.
